words.defn_en: friendly, peaceful:

sentences.en: The two companies reached an ______ agreement without going to court.
sentences.zh: 這兩家公司在未上法庭的情況下達成了友好的協議。

sentences.en: Despite their divorce, the couple remained on ______ terms for the sake of their children.
sentences.zh: 儘管離婚,這對夫妻為了孩子仍維持友好的關係。

words.defn_en: full of love:affectionate

sentences.en: The young couple exchanged ______ glances across the crowded room.
sentences.zh: 這對年輕情侶隔著擁擠的房間交換多情的眼神。

sentences.en: He wrote several ______ letters to her before finally confessing his feelings.
sentences.zh: 他在終於表白心意之前,寫了好幾封情意綿綿的情書給她。

words.defn_en: friendly, kind

sentences.en: Their ______ neighbor always waved and said hello.
sentences.zh: 他們那位友善的鄰居總是會揮手打招呼。

sentences.en: The two rivals maintained an ______ relationship off the field.
sentences.zh: 這兩位對手在賽場之外仍保持著友好的關係。

words.defn_en: a person who engages in an activity for enjoyment rather than as a profession:

sentences.en: Despite being an ______ , she painted with the skill of a professional.
sentences.zh: 雖然只是業餘愛好者,她的畫技卻不輸專業畫家。

sentences.en: The tournament is open only to ______ players, not professionals.
sentences.zh: 這場比賽只開放給業餘選手,不接受職業選手參加。

words.defn_en: a diplomatic official sent by a country to represent it abroad:

sentences.en: The new ______ presented her credentials to the president on Monday.
sentences.zh: 新任大使週一向總統呈遞到任國書。

sentences.en: The actor was named a goodwill ______ for the children's charity.
sentences.zh: 這位演員被任命為這家兒童慈善機構的親善大使。

words.defn_en: something with an especially delicious flavor or fragrance; the mythical food of the gods:

sentences.en: After the long hike, even plain bread tasted like ______.
sentences.zh: 長途健行後,連白麵包都嚐起來像瓊漿玉液。

sentences.en: Greek myths describe ______ as the food that granted the gods eternal life.
sentences.zh: 希臘神話描述瓊漿玉液是讓諸神長生不老的食物。

words.defn_en: extremely pleasing to taste or smell:

sentences.en: The bakery's ______ aroma drew customers in from the street.
sentences.zh: 麵包店裡飄出的香甜氣味,把路過的顧客都吸引了進來。

sentences.en: She described the mango as the most ______ fruit she had ever tasted.
sentences.zh: 她形容那顆芒果是她吃過最香甜可口的水果。

words.defn_en: to walk or move about:

sentences.en: The physical therapist encouraged him to ______ slowly around the ward.
sentences.zh: 物理治療師鼓勵他在病房裡慢慢走動。

sentences.en: Patients recovering from the surgery are asked to ______ within the first day.
sentences.zh: 手術後正在復原的病人,會被要求在第一天內就下床走動。

words.defn_en: walking or moving about:

sentences.en: An ______ vendor sold roasted chestnuts along the crowded street.
sentences.zh: 一位沿街叫賣的小販在擁擠的街道上賣著烤栗子。

sentences.en: The nurse checked on the ______ patients every hour to prevent falls.
sentences.zh: 護理師每小時查看正在走動的病人,以防跌倒。

words.defn_en: relating to walking; able to walk and not confined to bed:

sentences.en: Most patients are ______ within two days of the procedure.
sentences.zh: 大多數病人在手術後兩天內就能下床走動。

sentences.en: The clinic offers ______ surgery so patients can go home the same day.
sentences.zh: 這家診所提供門診手術,讓病人當天就能回家。

words.defn_en: an item that increases comfort:

sentences.en: The apartment complex offers ______s like a pool and a fitness center.
sentences.zh: 這棟公寓大樓提供游泳池和健身中心等便利設施。

sentences.en: Free breakfast is a nice ______ that many hotels now offer.
sentences.zh: 免費早餐是許多飯店現在提供的一項貼心設施。

words.defn_en: the quality of being friendly and pleasant:

sentences.en: The host's natural ______ put every guest at ease.
sentences.zh: 主人天生的和藹態度,讓每位賓客都感到自在。

sentences.en: Despite the tense negotiations, both sides maintained a surface ______.
sentences.zh: 儘管談判氣氛緊張,雙方表面上仍維持著和氣。

words.defn_en: friendliness and goodwill:

sentences.en: The divorce was settled with surprising ______ , to everyone's relief.
sentences.zh: 這場離婚以出乎意料的友好方式解決,讓大家都鬆了一口氣。

sentences.en: Years of ______ between the two neighboring towns made cooperation easy.
sentences.zh: 兩個鄰鎮多年的友好關係,讓合作變得容易。

words.defn_en: a friend (used especially in informal, friendly address):

sentences.en: "Come on in, ______ ," he said, waving his old college roommate inside.
sentences.zh: 「進來吧,朋友,」他一邊說,一邊招手讓大學室友進門。

sentences.en: The two became fast ______ after meeting on their first day of work.
sentences.zh: 兩人在上班第一天相遇後便迅速成為好友。

words.defn_en: friendly relations, especially between nations:

sentences.en: The treaty was meant to establish lasting ______ between the two former rivals.
sentences.zh: 這項條約旨在讓兩個昔日的對手建立長久的友好關係。

sentences.en: The two departments finally worked in ______ after months of conflict.
sentences.zh: 經過數月的衝突後,這兩個部門終於能和睦共事。

words.defn_en: self-esteem or self-respect, especially when easily wounded:

sentences.en: His ______ could not tolerate even the gentlest criticism.
sentences.zh: 他的自尊心連最溫和的批評都無法忍受。

sentences.en: Losing the election bruised her ______ far more than she admitted publicly.
sentences.zh: 選舉落敗對她自尊心的打擊,遠比她公開承認的更深。

words.defn_en: a small object worn for protection against evil or harm:

sentences.en: She never traveled without the small ______ her grandmother had given her.
sentences.zh: 她出門總是帶著祖母送她的那個小護身符。

sentences.en: The museum displayed an ancient Egyptian ______ believed to ward off illness.
sentences.zh: 博物館展出一枚被認為能驅除疾病的古埃及護身符。

words.defn_en: to fill with love, fascinate:

sentences.en: He was completely ______ed of the small coastal town after just one visit.
sentences.zh: 僅僅造訪一次,他就完全迷戀上了這座濱海小鎮。

sentences.en: The audience was ______ed with the young violinist's performance.
sentences.zh: 觀眾們對這位年輕小提琴家的演出深深著迷。

words.defn_en: filled with love or admiration for someone or something:

sentences.en: She became instantly ______ of the small coastal town.
sentences.zh: 她立刻迷戀上了這座濱海小鎮。

sentences.en: He was completely ______ with the idea of starting his own business.
sentences.zh: 他完全迷戀上創業的想法。

words.defn_en: a person or group actively opposed or hostile to another:

sentences.en: The two nations had long been bitter ______ ies.
sentences.zh: 這兩個國家長久以來都是不共戴天的敵人。

sentences.en: He made an ______ of his former business partner.
sentences.zh: 他和以前的生意夥伴結下了仇怨,成了敵人。

words.defn_en: ill will, hatred, hostility:

sentences.en: Decades of ______ between the two families finally came to an end.
sentences.zh: 這兩個家族間長達數十年的仇恨終於畫下句點。

sentences.en: The border dispute created lasting ______ between the neighboring countries.
sentences.zh: 這場邊界爭議在這兩個鄰國之間造成了長久的敵意。

words.defn_en: hostile, enemylike:

sentences.en: The harsh climate proved ______ to most forms of plant life.
sentences.zh: 這種嚴酷的氣候對大多數植物來說都相當不利。

sentences.en: The two rival companies remained ______ toward each other for years.
sentences.zh: 這兩家對立的公司多年來始終彼此敵對。

words.defn_en: to walk about or through a place, especially for pleasure:

sentences.en: They enjoyed the chance to ______ through the old city streets.
sentences.zh: 他們喜歡有機會漫步穿越這座老城的街道。

sentences.en: He would ______ the garden every evening before dinner.
sentences.zh: 他每天晚餐前都會在花園裡漫步。

words.defn_en: to walk while asleep:

sentences.en: As a child, he would occasionally ______ through the hallway at night.
sentences.zh: 他小時候偶爾會在夜裡沿著走廊夢遊。

sentences.en: Doctors advised locking the doors since she tended to ______ .
sentences.zh: 醫生建議把門鎖上,因為她有夢遊的傾向。

words.defn_en: the act of walking while asleep:

sentences.en: The clinic specializes in treating patients with severe ______ .
sentences.zh: 這間診所專門治療患有嚴重夢遊症的病人。

sentences.en: His ______ once led him to wander into the kitchen at 3 a.m.
sentences.zh: 他的夢遊症曾讓他在凌晨三點遊蕩到廚房。
